title: Section Meta File
description: Canonical contract for *.meta.json. The corpus contains TWO meta generations: the 'engineering' generation (course/chapter/section present, 20 files) and the 'supplement' generation (those keys absent, 236 files). Backfilling course/chapter/section into the 236 supplement metas is a deferred metadata pass, so this schema requires only the keys present in every meta today (`title`) and validates the optional keys when present. `practice_ids`, when present, must reference real problem ids in the sibling practice file (enforced by the cross-file checks in validate_content.py).
